title: gh api repos/${repo}/pulls/${number} --jq .user.login
description: One pull request, ${repo} the repository's owner/name, whose author's login kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:pr-author): a bot's as the page shows it, such as dependabot[bot]. The types are pull-request of GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number} in GitHub's REST OpenAPI description, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/rest-api-description/main/descriptions/api.github.com/api.github.com.json, whose user is a simple-user.
